necessity_paragraph: The claim for CPT 93226 was denied under reason code PR-204, but the service is medically necessary for the patient with diagnosis codes I48.91 and I49.9. The clinical indication note states the patient presents with a history of unspecified atrial fibrillation and cardiac arrhythmia, reporting persistent episodes of palpitations. A 48-hour Holter monitor was ordered to further characterize the arrhythmia burden and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances.
